text:
Sara Patel: Quick idea — tiny winter window photo challenge! post a pic of your workstation/window view and we'll crown The Coziest View. :snowflake: rules: 1) one pic per person 2) caption your drink of choice 3) react with :sparkles: to vote
Jamal Reynolds: Love this. I'll post after i finish lunch. tea > coffee fight incoming :tea: :laughing:
Chris L.: ok here's mine — https://imgur.com/a/example1 tiny cinnamon latte, cat refused to cooperate (10/10 background model) :cat2:
Anya M.: posting from the office — fairy lights + mini tree by my monitor. peppermint mocha caption. :candy:
Maria (she/her): remote sunset shot from my window, hot cocoa on the sill. posting now. ETA 2m. :heart_eyes:
decor-bot: New poll created: "Coziest View" — react with :sparkles: to vote. Poll ends in 1 hour.
Sara Patel: rules reminder: be chill, no pressure, family-friendly pics only. tagging @here for more entries :bell:
Jamal Reynolds: here's mine — street lamps + light snow, mug of matcha. kinda proud of this one https://imgur.com/a/example2 :snowman_with_snow:
Chris L.: @Jamal that's gorgeous. also, tiny tip — ambient white lights look warmer in pic if you put phone on night mode. learned that too late lol
Anya M.: decided to add a tiny paper garland, instant upgrade. here's my photo: https://imgur.com/a/example3 :sparkles:
Maria (she/her): voting time! :sparkles: for @Chris L. the cat steals it for me :joy_cat:
Sara Patel: tally so far: @Maria -> Chris, @Chris -> Jamal? (jk) keep 'em coming — will share final screenshot when poll closes. also if you want to share a 1-line how-you-made-it tip that'd be cool.
Jamal Reynolds: tip: put a small warm lamp behind your plant to create depth. also, cinnamon on top of latte makes people think it took more effort than it did :wink:
decor-bot: Poll ended. Results: 1) Chris L. (4 reactions) 2) Jamal Reynolds (3) 3) Anya M. (2) 4) Maria (1). Congratulations @Chris L.! :tada: Prize: eternal bragging rights + a custom slack emoji of your cat if you want it.
Chris L.: omg thank you! will accept the tiny throne and the emoji offer :grin: also love this — next month: Ugly Mug Contest? :mug:
